verdict.rationale: Search analytics is a fair question for a search engine, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about built-in analytics for top queries, no-result queries, or click-through. General aggregations and audit-event logging are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, built-in analytics show top queries, no-result queries, and click-through so I know what users search for and miss
